name: market_overview
description: Delivery: a compact market-regime evidence pack with sentiment, market totals, dominance, movers, and explicit data gaps. Use when: an agent needs a broad market briefing before token research. Core inputs: none. Limits: research context only; incomplete lanes are marked partial or unavailable.

name: scan_market
description: Delivery: a ranked candidate set with price, momentum, market-activity evidence, filters, and reasons where available. Use when: an agent needs a shortlist before deeper token analysis. Core inputs: optional chain, theme, and top_n. Limits: theme is contextual rather than a strict filter; a scan is not a trade instruction.

name: analyze_token
description: Delivery: a single-token research pack with USD market data, multi-window performance, calculated RSI and ATR, intelligence, summary, and warnings. Use when: an agent needs a quick structured token read. Core input: symbol. Limits: missing measurements are reported as unavailable and the result is not execution advice.

chain.description: Chain slug for contract-specific safety, e.g. eth/bsc (optional).

name: deep_analysis
description: Delivery: a deeper token evidence pack combining market context, confluence, technicals, an optional Skill Hub token profile, derivatives, catalysts, risks, and a measured-ATR preview plan. Use when: an agent needs one comprehensive token read. Core input: token symbol; optional include_perp. Limits: token analysis only, not wallet analysis; unavailable lanes remain explicit and no trade is placed.

name: compare_tokens
description: Delivery: a side-by-side comparison of two to four tokens with factor winners, coverage by token, an overall pick, rationale, confidence, and conclusion method. Use when: an agent must compare relative momentum, market activity, and volatility using common data. Core inputs: symbols; optional intent. Limits: missing factors are disclosed and deterministic conclusions are labelled.

symbols.description: 2-4 token symbols to compare, comma- or space-separated, e.g. 'SOL, AVAX'.

intent.description: Trade horizon the pick is for: swing | hold | spot (optional).

name: monitor_market_sentiment_shift
description: Delivery: a seven-day market sentiment evidence pack containing Fear & Greed level and change, BTC perpetual funding crowding, BTC liquidation pressure and side, altseason phase, the combined regime, observation dates, coverage scope, and full measurements. Use when: an agent needs to check whether market sentiment materially shifted. Core inputs: optional time_window fixed to 7d. Limits: market-wide context except for BTC-referenced derivatives; no causality claim or advice.

time_window.description: Sentiment comparison window; currently fixed to seven days.
